# Why this section exists

The teaching wiki keeps the day-by-day path visible — *what we do this week* next to *the whole journey*. When an AI course is confirmed, this section will hold that same pattern for the ML wiki.

Albert owns the official course docs. This page does not invent a course folder, a calendar, or a sprint that does not exist yet.

# What you will find later

For each confirmed course edition, the same four kinds of page as on albertprofe.dev:

- Official docs
- Sprint Backlog (the live week)
- Product Backlog (the history)
- Calendar & Deliveries

# What you will not find today

- No course edition folder.
- No sprint table.
- No invented dates or student counts.

The library itself — articles and labs — lives in the other sections. Training will point at them, the same way a sprint on albertprofe.dev points at Java, Spring or React pages without swallowing them.

# Labs and resources

See [Labs](labs.qmd) and [Resources](resources.qmd) for this section. About this wiki: there is no About page in the ML navbar; see [About on albertprofe.dev](https://albertprofe.dev/about/about-this-me.html){.external target="_blank"}.
